Magma blocks are on the floor surface inside the enclosed cyan_terracotta corridor; player must enter corridor first to locate them
The spruce_door is on the east wall of the entrance hall; player orients from the banner to find the only door leading to the garden wing
Sugar cane is inside the fully enclosed garden wing, only accessible by passing through the spruce_door
The red_mushroom_block is inside the enclosed garden wing at (9,0,1), only reachable through the spruce_door
The bedroom with green_bed is only accessible through the garden wing's south opening, which requires passing through the spruce_door first
Pink wool blocks are decorative elements inside the same enclosed bedroom; player must enter the room (finding the bed) to access wool

From spawn distance is 7.07 blocks which exceeds max_distance=5, forcing the player to walk into the corridor. WHY position_near_with_facing: the block is pre-placed and the player must navigate to and observe it.

Uses inventory_has because mining magma_block with the provided diamond pickaxe drops the magma_block item into inventory. Magma blocks are on the corridor floor at y=0. WHY inventory_has: the mined block ends up in inventory and is not in starting inventory.

WHY position_near_with_facing: the door is pre-placed and the player must navigate to it and face it.

Uses inventory_has because breaking sugar cane drops the sugar_cane item into inventory instantly. Sugar cane is in the garden at (8,0,-1) and (7,0,0) on grass adjacent to water. WHY inventory_has: the harvested item ends up in inventory and is not in starting inventory.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/observe' task. The red mushroom block is at (9,0,1) in the garden wing. From spawn distance is 9.06 blocks which far exceeds max_distance=4, forcing navigation through the spruce door into the garden. WHY position_near_with_facing: the block is pre-placed and the player must navigate to and observe it.

Uses inventory_has because breaking pink_wool drops the pink_wool block item into inventory. Wool drops itself when broken by any means. Pink wool is at (9,0,5), (10,0,5), and (9,0,8) in the bedroom. WHY inventory_has: the mined block ends up in inventory and is not in starting inventory.

Uses inventory_has because crafting an acacia_button (1 acacia plank in any crafting grid) places the result in inventory. Acacia planks are in the chest at (13,0,4) and a crafting table is at (13,0,3). WHY inventory_has: the crafted item ends up in inventory and is not in starting inventory.

scene_description: A multi-room enclosed building complex with enforced navigation paths. Entrance hall at center with brown wall banner visible from spawn. West corridor has cyan terracotta walls with magma blocks on floor. East spruce door leads to enclosed garden with sugar cane and red mushroom block. South from garden leads to bedroom with green bed and pink wool. East from garden leads to polished granite slab walkway with chest containing acacia planks and a crafting table.
task_text: Explore this building complex. Find the brown banner on the wall, then navigate west to the cyan terracotta corridor and mine a magma block from the floor. Return to the entrance and go through the spruce door east into the garden. Harvest sugar cane, find the red mushroom block, then go south into the bedroom to find the green bed and mine pink wool. Finally, exit east onto the polished granite slab walkway, find the chest with acacia planks, and craft an acacia button.
design_notes: Complete 63-command list. Layout: Player spawns at (0,0,0) inside entrance hall. Brown wall banner on interior north wall at (0,2,2) facing south — visible from spawn. West opening at (-3,0,0) leads to nether corridor (x=-10 to x=-4, z=-2 to z=2) with cyan terracotta walls and 4 magma blocks on floor at y=0. East wall has spruce door at (3,0,0) leading to garden (x=4 to x=11, z=-3 to z=3) with grass floor, water at (7,0,-1), sugar cane at (8,0,-1) and (7,0,0), red mushroom block at (9,0,1). South opening from garden at (8,0,3)/(8,0,4) leads to bedroom (x=5 to x=11, z=4 to z=9) with green bed at (7,0,6-7) and pink wool at (9,0,5), (10,0,5), (9,0,8). East opening from garden at (11,0,1) leads to granite walkway (x=12-14, z=-1 to z=5) with polished granite slab floor, chest with 4 acacia planks at (13,0,4), and crafting table at (13,0,3). All rooms fully enclosed with solid walls enforcing single-entry navigation. Added ceiling to walkway (command 59) for full enclosure.
